title: Migration Checklist
description: Post-migration verification steps for moved WordPress sites.

steps.title: Verify Site URL
steps.instructions: Confirm WordPress Address and Site Address match the live domain.

steps.title: Run URL Search-Replace
steps.instructions: Run serialized-safe search-replace for old domain references in database.

steps.title: Flush Permalinks
steps.instructions: Visit Settings → Permalinks and save to flush rewrite rules.

steps.title: Verify SSL Certificate
steps.instructions: Confirm HTTPS works without mixed-content warnings.

steps.title: Verify WP-Cron
steps.instructions: Ensure wp-cron or system cron is firing scheduled tasks.

steps.title: Test Email Delivery
steps.instructions: Send a test email from contact form or WP mail to verify SMTP.
